summary: Verified fix of passlib->bcrypt for admin CPF login. Backend & frontend flows tested. Admin CPF login POST /api/auth/login/cpf returns 200 with session_token. /api/auth/me works. /api/auth/change-password validates old password, rejects same-as-current, changes password successfully, and login continues to work post-change. Frontend: entered CPF 154.831.997-07 + admin123, clicked ENTRAR, dashboard loaded showing 'Administrador'. Also found and FIXED an unrelated pymongo bug: 'if not strategies_col:' raised NotImplementedError (Collection truthiness). Replaced with 'is None' comparison; /api/strategies now returns 200 with data.

issues: Recharts container width/height 0 warnings on initial render (cosmetic)

critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 1264/1280/1301/1320 used 'if not strategies_col:' which throws NotImplementedError with pymongo Collections. Fixed by using 'is None' comparison.
server.py is ~1700 lines; consider splitting into modules (auth, admin, payments, strategies).
Cookie set_cookie samesite='none' with secure=True is correct for cross-site, but frontend also uses Authorization Bearer token; ensure only one auth mechanism is primary to avoid confusion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: bcrypt direct usage confirmed working on this Python 3.11 preview env. The Railway target is Python 3.12, but bcrypt API is version-agnostic so fix should hold. Strategies endpoint had a separate latent bug (pymongo Collection bool) which was fixed in this iteration.
rca of the issue: Original bug (passlib+bcrypt>=4.1 on Py3.12): passlib introspects bcrypt.__about__ which was removed in bcrypt 4.1+, causing AttributeError during hash/verify. Fix: replaced passlib.CryptContext with direct bcrypt.hashpw/checkpw calls (server.py:106-113). Confirmed login and password-change flows work.
